title: Story of Seasons maker Marvelous to cut 65 jobs 🌾
subject: marvelous
description:
What should Marvelous make next? 👇

Marvelous, publisher of Story of Seasons and Rune Factory, is offering voluntary early retirement to cut 65 jobs in its console and PC games division. Applications run December 14, 2026 to January 8, 2027, and the company expects about 220 million yen in costs.

Sources: Marvelous announcement via AUTOMATON (Nov 27, 2026), GGRecon (Nov 27, 2026), VGC
Game footage © Marvelous Inc.

scenes.text: Story of Seasons maker Marvelous wants to cut 65 jobs.
On November 27, the Japanese publisher opened voluntary early retirement in its console games division.
Applications run December 14 to January 8, with departures by March 31, 2027.
The payouts and job-search support should cost about 220 million yen, around $1.4 million.
The reason: bigger games and longer development cycles. It wants to mix in-house teams with outside studios.
The Rune Factory publisher says console games remain one of its core businesses.
